comments.author: @lovelymonster
comments.text: The tourguider know nothing about Bun Cha. The source in Hanoi is bland, including both sweet and sour. Compared to Hanoi, the source in Hoi An and Saigon is sweeter and saltier, Hoi An's is the saltiest.  Generally, the different tastes among Northern, Southern and the Middle are: (i) the northern people prefer the natural taste, less use sprices and follow the traditional rule of balance; (ii) the Southern people prefer the diversity and fusion, the topping for food is more interesting; (iii) the people in the middle of Vietnam prefer strong taste and use more spices.
